Bill.BriefDescription: Making improvements to the industrial insurance system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to improving the industrial insurance systemadministered by the department of labor and industries; and creating anew section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the industrialinsurance system administered by the department of labor and industriesshould be improved, using methods that meet all of the following goals: (1) The improvements should treat workers fairly; (2) The improvements should promote a sound and stable financialbasis for the system; and (3) The improvements should produce a system that is capable ofbeing administered efficiently and costeffectively.
